_about: What scripts/commons_clickthrough.js expects of each Commons link that names a List filter. compare: the List writes a figure that must equal the Commons' count (pattern: a regular expression over the List's notes whose first group is the figure; doubt_description: the description cards the Discipline in doubt note counts). differs: the written reason the two counts are in different units. unit: the List must say its counts' unit. A link with no entry fails, so a new Commons link gets its rule the day it ships.

#coci-lookup/list/seedless.pattern: Discipline no seed has touched: ([\d,]+) common courses? the auditor marks

#coci-lookup/list/units.pattern: A unit anomaly: ([\d,]+) common courses? the auditor marks

#coci-lookup/list/nodesc.pattern: No catalog description: ([\d,]+) common courses? the auditor marks

#coci-lookup/list/doubt.note: the Commons counts the description cards in kb/ccr_doubt.json, ruled ones too, until the next re-check drops them

#exhibits/list/left.differs: the Commons counts old titles no MAP exhibit uses (812); the Exhibits List counts its rows under A title that has left MAP (579). The Exhibits List does not yet say its unit; that change is in exhibits.js (the NEXT line on #3510 B2).

#exhibits/list/nosubj.differs: the Commons counts credentials with no Common SUBJ (499, on 461 exhibits); the Exhibits List counts its rows under No Common SUBJ (1,251). The unit on the Exhibits side waits on exhibits.js (NEXT on #3510 B2).

#program-requirements/list/fail.differs: the Commons counts active programs whose record fails a check; the Programs List counts the records it reads. The first nightly run records both figures.

#program-requirements/list/unread.differs: the Commons counts active programs with no record yet; the Programs List counts its own rows. The first nightly run records both figures.
